# raw text level checks
def raw(name, text):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","/app/submission/main.py"], input=text, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    if p.returncode != 2 or p.stdout:
        FAILS.append((name,"raw %r rc=%d out=%r" % (text[:60], p.returncode, p.stdout[:100])))
        print("FAIL",name, p.returncode, p.stdout[:80])
    else: print("ok",name)
